sheet.title.description: Title at the top of the notifications sheet, and the sheet's accessible name.

sheet.markAllRead.description: Button at the top of the notifications sheet, on the Unread filter: marks every notification as read.

sheet.markAppRead.description: Small button beside an app's name on the notifications sheet's Unread filter. It marks every unread notification from that app as read.

sheet.markAppReadLabel.description: Accessible name of that button. {{app}} is the project's name.

sheet.group.other.description: Heading on the Unread filter over the notifications that belong to no project (messages, friends, account).

stack.showAll_one.description: Last line of the top card of a closed stack of notifications on the Unread filter, one stack per project. {{count}} is how many notifications the whole stack holds, this card's included, and it is the only count the card shows while the stack is closed. Tapping the card opens the stack.

stack.showAll_other.description: Last line of the top card of a closed stack of notifications on the Unread filter, one stack per project. {{count}} is how many notifications the whole stack holds, this card's included, and it is the only count the card shows while the stack is closed. Tapping the card opens the stack.

stack.showLess.description: Small button beside a project's name on the Unread filter while its stack of notifications is open: folds the stack back under its newest notification.

stack.showLessLabel.description: Accessible name of that button. {{app}} is the project's name.

story.meta_one.description: Small last line of a card on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications about one request or proposal: which one, by its number, and how many notifications the card is. {{number}} is the request's or proposal's number, like 5580; {{count}} is how many notifications.

story.meta_other.description: Small last line of a card on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications about one request or proposal: which one, by its number, and how many notifications the card is. {{number}} is the request's or proposal's number, like 5580; {{count}} is how many notifications.

story.ref.description: Small last line of the top card of a closed stack on the Unread filter when that card stands for several notifications about one request or proposal: just which one, by its number. The card's last line says how many notifications the whole stack is, so this line gives no count. {{number}} is the request's or proposal's number, like 5580.

story.metaUnnumbered_one.description: Small last line of a card on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications about one request or proposal whose number is not known: how many notifications the card is. {{count}} is that number.

story.metaUnnumbered_other.description: Small last line of a card on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications about one request or proposal whose number is not known: how many notifications the card is. {{count}} is that number.

story.projectMeta.description: Small last line of a notification card that sits under no project heading (the older notifications on the Unread filter, one card per request or proposal): the card's project, emphasized, then the rest of the line. Keep the <0></0> tags around the project's name. {{project}} is the project's name, like Book club; {{meta}} is the rest of the line, like "#5580 · 3 notifications" or "by @ana".

history.show.description: Accessible name of the small arrow at the foot of a notification about a request or proposal: opens, inside the card, everything that happened on it (votes, comments, updates, going live).

history.hide.description: Accessible name of that arrow while the card's history is open: closes it.

history.loading.description: Shown inside a notification card while what happened on its request or proposal is being fetched.

history.failed.description: Shown inside a notification card when what happened on its request or proposal could not be fetched.

history.empty.text: Nothing else has happened here yet.
history.empty.description: Shown inside a notification card when its request or proposal has no other activity to show.

history.on.description: First line of a notification card's history: the request or proposal the notification was posted on. {{number}} is its number, like 5588; its title is shown under it.

history.step.live.description: One line of a notification card's history: the change was merged and is live in the project.

history.step.updated.description: One line of a notification card's history: the proposal's change was updated with new work.

history.step.closed.description: One line of a notification card's history: the request was closed because the group voted to close it.

history.step.withdrawn.description: One line of a notification card's history: the proposal was withdrawn by the person who made it.

history.step.voteYes.description: One line of a notification card's history: someone voted for the proposal. {{who}} is who did it: their @handle, like @ana, or Homeroom bot.

history.step.voteYesYou.description: One line of a notification card's history: the viewer voted for the proposal.

history.step.voteNo.description: One line of a notification card's history: someone voted against the proposal. {{who}} is who did it: their @handle, like @ana, or Homeroom bot.

history.step.voteNoYou.description: One line of a notification card's history: the viewer voted against the proposal.

history.step.votesYes_one.description: One line of a notification card's history: several people voted for the proposal, one after another; their names are on the line under it. {{count}} is how many.

history.step.votesYes_other.description: One line of a notification card's history: several people voted for the proposal, one after another; their names are on the line under it. {{count}} is how many.

history.step.votesNo_one.description: One line of a notification card's history: several people voted against the proposal, one after another; their names are on the line under it. {{count}} is how many.

history.step.votesNo_other.description: One line of a notification card's history: several people voted against the proposal, one after another; their names are on the line under it. {{count}} is how many.

history.step.voteTakenBack.description: One line of a notification card's history: someone withdrew the vote they had cast. {{who}} is who did it: their @handle, like @ana, or Homeroom bot.

history.step.voteTakenBackYou.description: One line of a notification card's history: the viewer withdrew the vote they had cast.

history.step.voteTakenBackUnnamed.description: One line of a notification card's history: someone withdrew the vote they had cast, and who is not known.

history.step.proposed.text: {{who}} put it up for a vote
history.step.proposed.description: One line of a notification card's history: someone proposed the change, so the group can vote on it. {{who}} is who did it: their @handle, like @ana, or Homeroom bot.

history.step.proposedYou.text: You put it up for a vote
history.step.proposedYou.description: One line of a notification card's history: the viewer proposed the change, so the group can vote on it.

history.step.plan.description: One line of a notification card's history: someone shared a written plan for the change; its title is on the line under it. {{who}} is who did it: their @handle, like @ana, or Homeroom bot.

history.step.planYou.description: One line of a notification card's history: the viewer shared a written plan for the change; its title is on the line under it.

history.step.planUnnamed.description: One line of a notification card's history: a written plan for the change was shared; its title is on the line under it.

history.step.asked.description: One line of a notification card's history: someone filed the request. {{who}} is who did it: their @handle, like @ana, or Homeroom bot.

history.step.askedYou.description: One line of a notification card's history: the viewer filed the request.

history.step.closeProposed.description: One line of a notification card's history: someone asked the group to vote on closing the request. {{who}} is who did it: their @handle, like @ana, or Homeroom bot.

history.step.closeProposedYou.description: One line of a notification card's history: the viewer asked the group to vote on closing the request.

history.step.comment.description: One line of a notification card's history: someone wrote in the request's or proposal's discussion; their words are on the line under it. {{who}} is who did it: their @handle, like @ana, or Homeroom bot.

history.step.commentYou.description: One line of a notification card's history: the viewer wrote in the request's or proposal's discussion; their words are on the line under it.

sheet.filters.description: Accessible name of the row of two filter buttons (Unread, All) at the top of the notifications sheet.

sheet.tab.unread.description: Filter button at the top of the notifications sheet: shows only notifications not yet read. Used when there are none.

sheet.tab.unreadCount_one.description: Filter button at the top of the notifications sheet: shows only notifications not yet read. {{count}} is how many there are.

sheet.tab.unreadCount_other.description: Filter button at the top of the notifications sheet: shows only notifications not yet read. {{count}} is how many there are.

sheet.tab.unreadCountCapped.description: Filter button at the top of the notifications sheet when more than 99 notifications are unread: the same capped number the bell's badge shows.

sheet.tab.all.description: Filter button at the top of the notifications sheet: shows every notification, read ones included.

sheet.today.description: Heading over the notifications that arrived today, in the notifications sheet.

sheet.earlier.description: Heading over the notifications that arrived before today, in the notifications sheet.

sheet.yesterday.description: Heading over the older notifications that arrived yesterday, on the notifications sheet's Unread filter once its older notifications are showing.

sheet.lastWeek.description: Heading over the older notifications that arrived in the rest of the past week (from two to six days ago), on the notifications sheet's Unread filter once its older notifications are showing. It follows the Today and Yesterday headings.

sheet.longAgo.description: Heading over the older notifications that arrived more than a week ago, on the notifications sheet's Unread filter once its older notifications are showing. It follows the Last 7 days heading.

sheet.empty.unread.description: Shown in the notifications sheet when the Unread filter has nothing in it.

sheet.empty.other.text: Nothing here yet. You’ll get pinged here.
sheet.empty.other.description: Shown in the notifications sheet when the All filter has nothing in it. "Pinged" means notified.

sheet.older.loading.description: Shown on the button at the foot of the notifications sheet while older notifications are being fetched.

sheet.older.unread.description: Button at the foot of the notifications sheet's Unread filter: fetches the next batch of unread notifications the bell counts but the sheet has not loaded yet.

sheet.older.reveal.description: Button at the foot of the notifications sheet's Unread filter: shows the older, mostly read notifications under the unread ones, on the same tab, and loads the next batch if the server has one.

sheet.older.hide.description: Button at the foot of the notifications sheet's Unread filter once the older notifications are showing: collapses the list back to just the unread ones.

sheet.older.load.description: Button at the foot of the notifications sheet's All filter: fetches the next page of older notifications (with a kind filter on, the older ones of that kind join the list).

sheet.kinds.description: Accessible name of the row of kind filters (Votes, Mentions & replies, Invites) under the Unread and All filters, on the All filter of the notifications sheet.

sheet.kind.votes.description: Filter chip on the notifications sheet's All filter: shows only notifications about votes (a change up for your vote, going stale, ready to try, a vote on your change, a change you voted on going live).

sheet.kind.mentions.description: Filter chip on the notifications sheet's All filter: shows only notifications where someone named you with @ or replied to you, in a project's chat, a request or a conversation.

sheet.kind.invites.description: Filter chip on the notifications sheet's All filter: shows only invitations (to build or approve on a project, to join a conversation) and friend requests.

sheet.empty.kind.description: Shown in the notifications sheet when a kind filter (Votes, Mentions & replies or Invites) on the All filter has nothing in it among the notifications loaded so far.

sheet.search.placeholder.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the search field between the title and the Unread and All filters in the notifications sheet. It narrows the notifications already loaded to those whose project, kind or subject matches.

sheet.search.noMatches.description: Shown in the notifications sheet when a search over the loaded notifications finds nothing. {{query}} is the text typed into the search field.

row.clear.description: Action revealed by swiping an unread notification on a phone: marks that notification as read without opening it. A verb.

row.clearLabel.description: Accessible name of the small × button on an unread notification: marks that notification as read without opening it.

row.clearGroupLabel_one.description: Accessible name of the small × button on a notification row that stands for several notifications of one kind in one project: marks all of them as read without opening them. {{count}} is how many.

row.clearGroupLabel_other.description: Accessible name of the small × button on a notification row that stands for several notifications of one kind in one project: marks all of them as read without opening them. {{count}} is how many.

row.save.description: Accessible name of the bookmark button at the right end of a notification row that is not saved: pins that notification in the Saved section at the top. It also names the bookmark beside a notification listed in a card's history.

row.unsave.description: Accessible name of the bookmark button at the right end of a notification row the viewer has saved: removes it from the Saved section at the top. The button is the same one, pressed, and it also names the bookmark beside a saved notification listed in a card's history.

row.swipeSave.description: Action revealed by swiping a notification on a phone: saves it for later, in the Saved section at the top of the sheet. A verb.

row.swipeUnsave.description: Action revealed by swiping a saved notification on a phone: takes it out of the Saved section. A verb.

row.unreadDot.description: Accessible name of the dot at the right of a notification that has not been read.

row.runCount_one.description: Accessible name of the number at the right of a row that stands for several notifications from one conversation. {{count}} is how many.

row.runCount_other.description: Accessible name of the number at the right of a row that stands for several notifications from one conversation. {{count}} is how many.

row.group.votedMerged_one.text: {{count}} change you voted on is live
row.group.votedMerged_one.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. Changes the viewer voted for were merged and are now live.

row.group.votedMerged_other.text: {{count}} changes you voted on are live
row.group.votedMerged_other.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. Changes the viewer voted for were merged and are now live.

row.group.proposed_one.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. New changes were put up for a vote.

row.group.proposed_other.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. New changes were put up for a vote.

row.group.stale_one.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. Proposed changes are waiting for more votes.

row.group.stale_other.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. Proposed changes are waiting for more votes.

row.group.checkFailed_one.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. The automatic tests could not run on these proposed changes.

row.group.checkFailed_other.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. The automatic tests could not run on these proposed changes.

row.group.issueOpened_one.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. New requests were filed in the project.

row.group.issueOpened_other.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. New requests were filed in the project.

row.group.issueMention_one.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. Someone mentioned the viewer in requests.

row.group.issueMention_other.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. Someone mentioned the viewer in requests.

row.group.reaction_one.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. People reacted to the viewer's messages.

row.group.reaction_other.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. People reacted to the viewer's messages.

row.group.sessionDone_one.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. The viewer's coding sessions finished their work.

row.group.sessionDone_other.description: Heading of a notification row on the Unread filter that stands for several notifications of the same kind from one project, folded into one row. {{count}} is how many. The viewer's coding sessions finished their work.

row.sending.description: Shown on a notification's "Still yes" button while the vote is being sent.

row.meta.sourceByWhen.description: Small last line of a notification. {{source}} is the project's name or the area it came from (Messages, Account), {{username}} is who did it, and {{when}} is how long ago ("4m ago") or a date. Keep the @ before the username.

row.meta.sourceWhen.description: Small last line of a notification nobody in particular caused. {{source}} is the project's name or the area it came from (Messages, Account), and {{when}} is how long ago ("4m ago") or a date.

row.meta.byWhen.description: Small last line of a notification that names no project. {{username}} is who did it and {{when}} is how long ago ("4m ago") or a date. Keep the @ before the username.

row.meta.sourceBy.description: Small last line of a notification whose time is not known. {{source}} is the project's name or the area it came from and {{username}} is who did it. Keep the @ before the username.

row.meta.by.description: Small last line of a notification that names no project and has no known time. {{username}} is who did it. Keep the @ before the username.

row.factPair.description: Joins two short facts on one line of a notification ("2 changes went live · 1 change is waiting for approval"). {{first}} and {{second}} are each already a complete phrase. Use the separator your language uses between such facts.

row.unknownPerson.description: Stands in for a username on a notification when the person is not known. It is shown after an @ sign, as "@someone", so keep it one lower-case word.

row.source.messages.description: Where a notification came from, on its small last line: a conversation on the Messages screen.

row.source.friends.description: Where a notification came from, on its small last line: the viewer's friends.

row.source.account.description: Where a notification came from, on its small last line: it is about the viewer's own account, not a project.

row.source.admin.description: Where a notification came from, on its small last line: the admin console. Only administrators get these.

row.source.discussion.description: Where a notification came from, on its small last line: a project's Discussion (its group chat). A noun.

row.testAlert.label.description: First line of the notification sent when a person tests push notifications from Settings. Homeroom is the product's name.

row.testAlert.body.text: You requested a push notification test. Open Alerts settings to try again.
row.testAlert.body.description: Second line of the test notification a person sent themselves from Settings. "Open" is a verb; "Alerts" is the name of that Settings section.

row.conversation.untitled.description: Stands in for a conversation's name on a notification when the conversation has no title of its own.

row.conversation.invite.description: First line of a notification: the viewer was added to a conversation. A noun (an invitation). The conversation's name is on the line below.

row.conversation.inviteNote.description: Appended to a group invitation row after the group's name when the inviter wrote a note about why you were added. {{note}} is their note.

row.conversation.mention.description: First line of a notification: somebody named the viewer with @ in a conversation. The conversation's name is on the line below and who did it on the last line.

row.conversation.reply.description: First line of a notification: somebody replied to the viewer's message in a conversation. The conversation's name is on the line below and who did it on the last line.

row.conversation.threadReply.description: First line of a notification: somebody answered in a reply thread the viewer started or took part in, in a conversation. The conversation's name is on the line below.

row.conversation.reaction.description: First line of a notification: somebody reacted with an emoji to the viewer's message in a conversation. The conversation's name is on the line below and who did it on the last line.

row.bot.name.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot, the built-in assistant that builds changes: its name. Homeroom is the product's name.

row.bot.label.needsYou.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot, the built-in assistant that builds what people ask for: one of the viewer's requests needs their answer or decision before the bot goes on. The request's title is on the line below.

row.bot.label.ready.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot: what the viewer asked for is built and can be tried. The request's title is on the line below.

row.bot.label.stopped.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot: work on one of the viewer's requests stopped. The request's title is on the line below; the reason is in their chat with the bot.

row.bot.label.onHold.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot: work on the viewer's requests waits until Monday, because this week's building time is used up. The request's title (or how many requests) is on the line below.

row.bot.label.live.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot: what the viewer asked for is now part of the running project. The request's title is on the line below.

row.bot.label.doneElsewhere.description: Label at the head of a notification from Homeroom bot: somebody else's change shipped a request the bot was working on, so it has nothing more to build.

row.bot.ask.question.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot, the built-in assistant that builds what people ask for: it has a question for the viewer about one of their requests before it builds it. The request's title is on the line below.

row.bot.ask.questions.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot: it has two questions for the viewer about one of their requests before it builds it. The request's title is on the line below.

row.bot.ask.plan.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot: its plan for one of the viewer's requests is ready, and it builds once the viewer approves it. The request's title is on the line below.

row.bot.ask.decide.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot: one of the viewer's requests needs the viewer to decide whether it should go ahead before the bot builds it. The request's title is on the line below.

row.bot.ask.waitingOn.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot: one of the viewer's requests needs a decision from other people before the bot builds it. {{people}} names them, like "@ana" or "@ana and @ben". The request's title is on the line below.

row.bot.ask.waitingOnUnnamed.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot: one of the viewer's requests needs a decision from other people before the bot builds it, when who they are is not known. The request's title is on the line below.

row.bot.ask.moreDetail.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot: the bot could not build one of the viewer's requests as written and asks them to add detail. The request's title is on the line below.

row.bot.ask.done.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot: what one of the viewer's requests asks for seems to exist already, and the bot offers to close it. The request's title is on the line below.

row.bot.ask.platform.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot: one of the viewer's requests is about the Homeroom platform itself rather than this project, and the bot offers to move it to Homeroom's own list of requests. Homeroom is the product's name. The request's title is on the line below.

row.bot.subject.firstVersion.description: Second line of a notification from Homeroom bot, in bold: the first version of a new project the bot builds for the viewer. {{project}} is the project's name.

row.bot.subject.firstVersionUnnamed.description: Second line of a notification from Homeroom bot, in bold: the first version of a new project the bot builds for the viewer, when the project's name is not known.

row.bot.subject.request.description: Second line of a notification from Homeroom bot, in bold: the request it is about, by its number, when its title is not known. {{number}} is the request's number, like 5308.

row.bot.subject.onHold_one.description: Second line of a notification from Homeroom bot, in bold: how many of the viewer's requests wait until Monday. {{count}} is that number.

row.bot.subject.onHold_other.description: Second line of a notification from Homeroom bot, in bold: how many of the viewer's requests wait until Monday. {{count}} is that number.

row.bot.meta.description: Small grey line under a notification from Homeroom bot, before the time: the project it is about, then who it is from. {{project}} is the project's name; Homeroom bot is the assistant's name.

row.bot.metaRequest.description: Small grey line under a notification from Homeroom bot, before the time: the project it is about, the request's number, then who it is from. {{project}} is the project's name and {{number}} the request's number, like 5308; Homeroom bot is the assistant's name.

row.friend.request.description: First line of a notification: somebody asked to be the viewer's friend. Their username is on the line below.

row.friend.accepted.description: First line of a notification: somebody accepted the viewer's friend request. Their username is on the line below.

row.friend.accept.description: Button on a friend-request notification: accepts the request, making the two people friends.

row.friend.decline.description: Button on a friend-request notification: turns the request down.

row.appDeleteAttempted.text: Tried to delete this shared app
row.appDeleteAttempted.description: The whole text of a notification: somebody (named on the last line) tried to delete an app the viewer shares, and it was not deleted.

row.appDeleted.label.text: Deleted a shared app you contributed to
row.appDeleted.label.description: First line of a notification: somebody (named on the last line) deleted an app the viewer had worked on. The app's name is on the line below.

row.appDeleted.unnamed.description: Second line of the "Deleted a shared app you contributed to" notification when the deleted app's name is not known. Lower case: it stands where the name would.

row.moderation.report.description: First line of a notification about a report the viewer filed against content or a person: there is news on it. "Report" is a noun. The detail is on the line below.

row.moderation.action.description: First line of a notification: a moderator acted on the viewer's content or account. The detail is on the line below.

row.quota.changed.label.description: First line of a notification: the number of apps the viewer may create was changed by an administrator.

row.quota.changed.unknown.description: Second line of the "App allowance changed" notification when the old and new numbers are not known.

row.quota.changed.up_one.text: Your app allowance went up from {{before}} to {{count}} app slot.
row.quota.changed.up_one.description: Second line of the "App allowance changed" notification when the allowance grew. {{before}} is the old number of apps the viewer could create and {{count}} the new one. An "app slot" is room for one app.

row.quota.changed.up_other.text: Your app allowance went up from {{before}} to {{count}} app slots.
row.quota.changed.up_other.description: Second line of the "App allowance changed" notification when the allowance grew. {{before}} is the old number of apps the viewer could create and {{count}} the new one. An "app slot" is room for one app.

row.quota.changed.down_one.text: Your app allowance went down from {{before}} to {{count}} app slot.
row.quota.changed.down_one.description: Second line of the "App allowance changed" notification when the allowance shrank. {{before}} is the old number of apps the viewer could create and {{count}} the new one. An "app slot" is room for one app.

row.quota.changed.down_other.text: Your app allowance went down from {{before}} to {{count}} app slots.
row.quota.changed.down_other.description: Second line of the "App allowance changed" notification when the allowance shrank. {{before}} is the old number of apps the viewer could create and {{count}} the new one. An "app slot" is room for one app.

row.quota.changed.same_one.text: Your app allowance is {{count}} app slot.
row.quota.changed.same_one.description: Second line of the "App allowance changed" notification when the number did not actually move. {{count}} is how many apps the viewer may create. An "app slot" is room for one app.

row.quota.changed.same_other.text: Your app allowance is {{count}} app slots.
row.quota.changed.same_other.description: Second line of the "App allowance changed" notification when the number did not actually move. {{count}} is how many apps the viewer may create. An "app slot" is room for one app.

row.quota.requested.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: a person asked to be allowed more apps. Their username is on the line below. A past-tense verb: "(they) requested".

row.quota.declined.label.description: First line of a notification: the viewer's request to be allowed more apps was turned down.

row.quota.declined.body.description: Second line of the "App allowance request declined" notification.

row.openrouter.review.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: a person's OpenRouter API key needs checking. OpenRouter is a company's name. The person's username is on the line below.

row.openrouter.enabled.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: a person was given access to AI models through OpenRouter. OpenRouter is a company's name. The person's username is on the line below.

row.limit.unknown.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator about a server-wide limit, when its details cannot be read.

row.limit.unknown.body.text: the server is nearing one of its limits
row.limit.unknown.body.description: Second line of the "Platform limit" notification to an administrator, when its details cannot be read. Lower case, as a note under the heading.

row.limit.githubApp.full.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: the platform's GitHub App has no requests left for this hour. "GitHub App" is GitHub's name for that kind of integration.

row.limit.githubApp.warn.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: the platform's GitHub App has few requests left for this hour. "GitHub App" is GitHub's name for that kind of integration.

row.limit.github.full.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: the platform has no requests to GitHub left for this hour.

row.limit.github.warn.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: the platform has few requests to GitHub left for this hour.

row.limit.githubApp.body_one.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} GitHub App requests used this hour.</0> It resets within the hour.
row.limit.githubApp.body_one.description: Second line of a notification to an administrator about the GitHub App's hourly budget. {{used}} is how many requests were made and {{count}} the hourly limit. The part in <0> is shown bold. "It" is the count.

row.limit.githubApp.body_other.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} GitHub App requests used this hour.</0> It resets within the hour.
row.limit.githubApp.body_other.description: Second line of a notification to an administrator about the GitHub App's hourly budget. {{used}} is how many requests were made and {{count}} the hourly limit. The part in <0> is shown bold. "It" is the count.

row.limit.github.full.body_one.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} GitHub requests used this hour.</0> Work that needs GitHub fails until the hour resets.
row.limit.github.full.body_one.description: Second line of a notification to an administrator: the hourly budget of requests to GitHub is spent. {{used}} is how many requests were made and {{count}} the hourly limit. The part in <0> is shown bold.

row.limit.github.full.body_other.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} GitHub requests used this hour.</0> Work that needs GitHub fails until the hour resets.
row.limit.github.full.body_other.description: Second line of a notification to an administrator: the hourly budget of requests to GitHub is spent. {{used}} is how many requests were made and {{count}} the hourly limit. The part in <0> is shown bold.

row.limit.github.warn.body_one.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} GitHub requests used this hour.</0> Background work waits so people's work keeps the rest.
row.limit.github.warn.body_one.description: Second line of a notification to an administrator: the hourly budget of requests to GitHub is nearly spent, so automatic jobs are held back and what people do by hand gets the remainder. {{used}} is how many requests were made and {{count}} the hourly limit. The part in <0> is shown bold.

row.limit.github.warn.body_other.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} GitHub requests used this hour.</0> Background work waits so people's work keeps the rest.
row.limit.github.warn.body_other.description: Second line of a notification to an administrator: the hourly budget of requests to GitHub is nearly spent, so automatic jobs are held back and what people do by hand gets the remainder. {{used}} is how many requests were made and {{count}} the hourly limit. The part in <0> is shown bold.

row.limit.apps.full.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: the server holds as many apps as it is allowed to.

row.limit.apps.warn.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: the server holds almost as many apps as it is allowed to.

row.limit.sessions.full.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: as many coding sessions are running as the server allows.

row.limit.sessions.warn.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: almost as many coding sessions are running as the server allows.

row.limit.apps.full.body_one.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} apps in use.</0> New apps are refused until the app limit is raised in Admin → Limits or an app is removed.
row.limit.apps.full.body_one.description: Second line of the "App limit reached" notification to an administrator. {{used}} is how many apps exist and {{count}} the limit. The part in <0> is shown bold. "Admin → Limits" is the path to a section of the admin console.

row.limit.apps.full.body_other.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} apps in use.</0> New apps are refused until the app limit is raised in Admin → Limits or an app is removed.
row.limit.apps.full.body_other.description: Second line of the "App limit reached" notification to an administrator. {{used}} is how many apps exist and {{count}} the limit. The part in <0> is shown bold. "Admin → Limits" is the path to a section of the admin console.

row.limit.apps.warn.body_one.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} apps in use.</0> Raise the app limit in Admin → Limits before new apps are refused.
row.limit.apps.warn.body_one.description: Second line of the "Nearing the app limit" notification to an administrator. {{used}} is how many apps exist and {{count}} the limit. The part in <0> is shown bold. "Admin → Limits" is the path to a section of the admin console.

row.limit.apps.warn.body_other.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} apps in use.</0> Raise the app limit in Admin → Limits before new apps are refused.
row.limit.apps.warn.body_other.description: Second line of the "Nearing the app limit" notification to an administrator. {{used}} is how many apps exist and {{count}} the limit. The part in <0> is shown bold. "Admin → Limits" is the path to a section of the admin console.

row.limit.sessions.full.body_one.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} coding sessions in use.</0> New sessions pause idle ones, or wait, until the session limit is raised in Admin → Limits.
row.limit.sessions.full.body_one.description: Second line of the "Session limit reached" notification to an administrator. {{used}} is how many coding sessions are running and {{count}} the limit. The part in <0> is shown bold. "Admin → Limits" is the path to a section of the admin console.

row.limit.sessions.full.body_other.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} coding sessions in use.</0> New sessions pause idle ones, or wait, until the session limit is raised in Admin → Limits.
row.limit.sessions.full.body_other.description: Second line of the "Session limit reached" notification to an administrator. {{used}} is how many coding sessions are running and {{count}} the limit. The part in <0> is shown bold. "Admin → Limits" is the path to a section of the admin console.

row.limit.sessions.warn.body_one.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} coding sessions in use.</0> At the limit, idle sessions are paused to make room.
row.limit.sessions.warn.body_one.description: Second line of the "Nearing the session limit" notification to an administrator. {{used}} is how many coding sessions are running and {{count}} the limit. The part in <0> is shown bold.

row.limit.sessions.warn.body_other.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} coding sessions in use.</0> At the limit, idle sessions are paused to make room.
row.limit.sessions.warn.body_other.description: Second line of the "Nearing the session limit" notification to an administrator. {{used}} is how many coding sessions are running and {{count}} the limit. The part in <0> is shown bold.

row.incident.hour.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: many errors of one kind happened within an hour.

row.incident.hour.body_one.text: <0>{{count}} {{kind}} in the last hour.</0> Admin → Unexpected events has each one.
row.incident.hour.body_one.description: Second line of the "Unexpected events piling up" notification to an administrator. {{count}} is how many happened and {{kind}} the internal name of that kind of error, in English. The part in <0> is shown bold. "Admin → Unexpected events" is the path to a section of the admin console.

row.incident.hour.body_other.text: <0>{{count}} {{kind}} in the last hour.</0> Admin → Unexpected events has each one.
row.incident.hour.body_other.description: Second line of the "Unexpected events piling up" notification to an administrator. {{count}} is how many happened and {{kind}} the internal name of that kind of error, in English. The part in <0> is shown bold. "Admin → Unexpected events" is the path to a section of the admin console.

row.incident.digest.label_one.description: First line of a daily notification to an administrator. {{count}} is how many errors that should not happen were recorded the day before.

row.incident.digest.label_other.description: First line of a daily notification to an administrator. {{count}} is how many errors that should not happen were recorded the day before.

row.incident.digest.kindCount.description: One item in the list on the second line of an administrator's daily notification about unexpected events: {{kind}} is the internal name of a kind of error, in English, and {{count}} how many of it there were.

row.incident.digest.otherCount.description: Last item in the list on the second line of an administrator's daily notification about unexpected events: {{count}} is how many errors were of kinds not listed before it.

row.incident.digest.list.description: Second line of an administrator's daily notification about unexpected events. {{kinds}} is the finished list of kinds with their counts ("login failed 3, other 2"); only the closing punctuation is added here.

row.incident.digest.empty.description: Second line of an administrator's daily notification about unexpected events when it carries no breakdown. "Admin → Unexpected events" is the path to a section of the admin console.

row.incident.unknown.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator about errors that should not happen, when its details cannot be read.

row.incident.unknown.body.text: something that should not happen did
row.incident.unknown.body.description: Second line of the "Unexpected events" notification to an administrator, when its details cannot be read. Lower case, as a note under the heading.

row.incident.signal.label.text: A platform problem needs a person
row.incident.signal.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: Homeroom found a problem in itself that its bot cannot fix, and filed a request for a person.

row.incident.signal.body.text: Homeroom filed request #{{number}} on its own board from its own records.
row.incident.signal.body.description: Second line of the "A platform problem needs a person" notification to an administrator. {{number}} is the request's number on Homeroom's own board.

row.kudos.label.description: First line of a notification: another member gave the viewer kudos (a thank-you that counts on a leaderboard) for a change. "Kudos" is the feature's name.

row.kudos.yourChange.description: Second line of the Kudos notification when the title of the change that was thanked is not known. Lower case: it stands where the title would.

row.kudos.note.text: A thank-you from another member. Kudos you get don't expire; they count on the Kudos leaderboard. Everyone has {{limit}} a week to give.
row.kudos.note.description: Explanation under a Kudos notification. {{limit}} is how many kudos each member may give per week.

row.kudos.board.description: Button on a Kudos notification: opens the Kudos leaderboard.

row.reaction.label.description: First line of a notification: somebody reacted with an emoji to the viewer's message in a project's chat. The message is on the line below and who did it on the last line.

row.stale.label.description: First line of a notification: the viewer's proposed change has too few votes and will be archived if none come. The change's title is on the line below.

row.stale.blocked.description: First line of a notification: the viewer's proposed change has enough votes but cannot be merged (a conflict or failing checks), and will be archived if nothing changes. The change's title is on the line below.

row.stale.yourChange.description: Second line of the "Needs votes" notification when the change has no title. Lower case: it stands where the title would.

row.checkFailed.label.description: First line of a notification: the automatic tests of the viewer's proposed change could not be run at all. The change's title is on the line below.

row.checkFailed.yourChange.description: Second line of the "Testing couldn't run" notification when the change has no title. Lower case: it stands where the title would.

row.proposed.label.description: First line of a notification: somebody proposed a change to a project and the viewer can vote on it. "Change" is a noun. The change's title is on the line below.

row.proposed.aChange.description: Second line of the "New change" notification when the change has no title. Lower case: it stands where the title would.

row.changeReady.live.description: First line of a notification about a change the viewer was asked to approve: it has since been approved and is running. An adjective. The change's title is on the line below.

row.changeReady.goingLive.description: First line of a notification about a change the viewer was asked to approve: it was approved and is being put into the running project. The change's title is on the line below.

row.changeReady.closed.description: First line of a notification about a change the viewer was asked to approve: it was since withdrawn or archived without going live. An adjective describing the change. The change's title is on the line below.

row.changeReady.ready.description: First line of a notification: a change built for somebody is ready and needs the viewer's approval. The change's title is on the line below.

row.changeReady.aChange.description: Second line of a notification about a change the viewer was asked to approve, when the change has no title. Lower case: it stands where the title would.

row.merged.forced.description: First line of a notification: an administrator put the viewer's change into the running project without waiting for the vote. The change's title is on the line below.

row.merged.live.description: First line of a notification: the viewer's proposed change was approved and is now running. An adjective. The change's title is on the line below.

row.merged.goingLive.description: First line of a notification: the viewer's proposed change was approved and is being put into the running project, but is not running yet. The change's title is on the line below.

row.merged.yourChange.description: Second line of a notification that the viewer's change went live, when the change has no title. Lower case: it stands where the title would.

row.votedMerged.label.text: A change you voted on is live
row.votedMerged.label.description: First line of a notification: a change the viewer voted yes or no on was approved and is now running. The change's title is on the line below.

row.votedMerged.goingLive.text: A change you voted on is going live
row.votedMerged.goingLive.description: First line of a notification: a change the viewer voted yes or no on was approved and is being put into the running project, but is not running yet. The change's title is on the line below.

row.votedMerged.aChange.description: Second line of a notification that a change the viewer voted on went live, when the change has no title. Lower case: it stands where the title would.

row.vote.no.description: First line of a notification: somebody (named on the last line) voted against the viewer's proposed change. The change's title is on the line below.

row.vote.yes.description: First line of a notification: somebody (named on the last line) voted for the viewer's proposed change. The change's title is on the line below.

row.vote.yourChange.description: Second line of a "Voted yes" or "Voted no" notification when the change has no title. Lower case: it stands where the title would.

row.vote.reason.description: The voter's own comment, quoted after the change's title on a "Voted yes" or "Voted no" notification. {{reason}} is what they wrote; only the quotation marks are translated.

row.recheck.label.description: First line of a notification: a change the viewer approved was revised by its author, and the viewer is asked whether their approval still stands. The change's title is on the line below.

row.recheck.aChange.description: Second line of the "Still good?" notification when the change has no title. "Backed" means voted yes on. Lower case: it stands where the title would.

row.recheck.stillYes.description: Button on the "Still good?" notification: casts the viewer's yes vote again on the revised change.

row.weekly.label.description: First line of the weekly summary notification for one project. {{project}} is the project's name.

row.weekly.labelUnnamed.description: First line of the weekly summary notification when the project's name is not known.

row.weekly.nothing.description: In the weekly summary notification: no change went live in the project this week. "Landed" means was approved and went live.

row.weekly.wentLive_one.description: In the weekly summary notification. {{count}} is how many changes to the project were approved and started running this week.

row.weekly.wentLive_other.description: In the weekly summary notification. {{count}} is how many changes to the project were approved and started running this week.

row.weekly.waiting_one.description: In the weekly summary notification. {{count}} is how many proposed changes to the project are still being voted on.

row.weekly.waiting_other.description: In the weekly summary notification. {{count}} is how many proposed changes to the project are still being voted on.

row.issueOpened.label.description: First line of a notification: somebody filed a request (a bug report or an idea) on a project the viewer looks after. "Request" is a noun. Its number is on the line below.

row.issueOpened.filed.description: Second line of the "New request" notification when the request's number is not known: it says only that one was filed. Lower case, past participle.

row.issueOpened.number.description: Second line of the "New request" notification: the request's number, with the # that marks it as a reference.

row.issueMention.label.description: First line of a notification: somebody named the viewer with @ in a request they filed on a project. Which request is on the line below.

row.issueMention.request.description: Second line of the "Mentioned you" notification for a request filed on a project. {{number}} is the request's number. "Request" is a noun; lower case.

row.issueMention.aRequest.description: Second line of the "Mentioned you" notification for a request filed on a project, when its number is not known. "Request" is a noun; lower case.

row.health.storage.label.description: First line of a notification to the people who look after an app: it is about how much data the app has stored.

row.health.storage.warn.text: {{app}} has used most of its storage
row.health.storage.warn.description: Second line of the "App storage" notification: the app is close to its storage limit. {{app}} is the app's name.

row.health.storage.warnUnnamed.text: Your app has used most of its storage
row.health.storage.warnUnnamed.description: Second line of the "App storage" notification when the app's name is not known: the app is close to its storage limit.

row.health.storage.full.text: <0>{{app}} is out of storage.</0> New data cannot be saved until an admin raises its limit or allows time to clean up
row.health.storage.full.description: Second line of the "App storage" notification: the app reached its storage limit. {{app}} is the app's name. The part in <0> is shown bold.

row.health.storage.fullUnnamed.text: <0>Your app is out of storage.</0> New data cannot be saved until an admin raises its limit or allows time to clean up
row.health.storage.fullUnnamed.description: Second line of the "App storage" notification when the app's name is not known: the app reached its storage limit. The part in <0> is shown bold.

row.health.problem.label.description: First line of a notification to the people who look after an app: something is wrong with it. What is wrong is on the line below.

row.health.problem.deployFailed.text: an update did not go live
row.health.problem.deployFailed.description: Second line of the "App problem" notification: an approved update could not be started. Lower case, as a note under the heading.

row.health.problem.releaseStalled.text: an approved change has not gone live yet
row.health.problem.releaseStalled.description: Second line of the "App problem" notification: a change was approved some time ago but is still not running. Lower case, as a note under the heading.

row.health.problem.other.description: Second line of the "App problem" notification when the kind of problem is not known. Lower case, as a note under the heading.

row.voteDigest.none.text: Nothing is waiting for your approval now
row.voteDigest.none.description: The whole text of a daily reminder notification once every change it was about has been decided.

row.voteDigest.label.description: First line of a daily reminder notification: proposed changes the viewer has not voted on. How many is on the line below.

row.voteDigest.count_one.description: Second line of the "Waiting for your approval" notification. {{count}} is how many proposed changes still wait for the viewer's vote. "Change" is a noun.

row.voteDigest.count_other.description: Second line of the "Waiting for your approval" notification. {{count}} is how many proposed changes still wait for the viewer's vote. "Change" is a noun.

row.connector.shared.description: First line of a notification: the viewer's own AI coding agent put its work where others can see it, without asking for a vote. The work's title is on the line below.

row.connector.submitted.description: First line of a notification: the viewer's own AI coding agent put its work up for a vote. The work's title is on the line below.

row.connector.yourChange.description: Second line of a "Submitted by your agent" or "Shared by your agent" notification when the work has no title. Lower case: it stands where the title would.

row.agentAsked.description: First line of a notification, or its whole text: the AI coding agent asked the viewer a question while working. Claude is the agent's name. Past tense on purpose: it stays true after the viewer has answered.

row.session.agentFinished.description: First line of a notification: the AI coding agent finished the work it was given in an agent session. The session's title is on the line below.

row.session.finished.description: First line of a notification: the viewer's coding session finished its turn while they were away. The session's title is on the line below.

row.session.agentStopped.text: The coding agent stopped before finishing
row.session.agentStopped.description: First line of a notification: the AI coding agent's work in an agent session ended early, by an error or a timeout. The session's title is on the line below.

row.session.stopped.description: First line of a notification: the viewer's coding session ended early, by an error or a timeout. The session's title is on the line below.

row.session.yourSession.description: Second line of a notification about a coding session when the session has no title. Lower case: it stands where the title would.

row.autoSolve.failed.description: First line of a notification: the automatic attempt to build the change a request asked for failed. "Change" is a noun. Which request is on the line below.

row.autoSolve.question.description: First line of a notification: the automatic attempt to build the change a request asked for needs an answer from the viewer. "Change" is a noun. Which request is on the line below.

row.autoSolve.ready.description: First line of a notification: the change a request asked for was built automatically and can be tried. "Change" is a noun. Which request is on the line below.

row.autoSolve.request.description: Second line of a notification about a change built for a request. {{number}} is the request's number. "Request" is a noun; lower case.

row.autoSolve.aRequest.description: Second line of a notification about a change built for a request, when the request's number is not known. "Request" is a noun; lower case.

row.spec.label.description: First line of a notification: somebody (named on the last line) shared a plan, the written description of a planned change, with the viewer. Its title is on the line below.

row.spec.version.description: Second line of the "Plan shared" notification when the plan has no title: its version number, "v" for version. {{version}} is the number, or "?" when unknown.

spec.panelTitle.description: Title of the panel that opens from a "Plan shared" notification and shows that plan, the written description of a planned change. {{version}} is the plan's version number; "v" is for version.

row.channel.many_one.description: First line of a notification that stands for several unread messages in a project's group discussion. {{count}} is how many and {{project}} the project's name. The newest message is on the line below.

row.channel.many_other.description: First line of a notification that stands for several unread messages in a project's group discussion. {{count}} is how many and {{project}} the project's name. The newest message is on the line below.

row.channel.manyUnnamed_one.description: First line of a notification that stands for several unread messages in a project's group discussion, when the project's name is not known. {{count}} is how many.

row.channel.manyUnnamed_other.description: First line of a notification that stands for several unread messages in a project's group discussion, when the project's name is not known. {{count}} is how many.

row.channel.snippet.description: Second line of a notification for several new messages in a project's discussion: who wrote the newest one and what it says. Keep the @ before the username.

row.channel.snippetSomeone.description: Second line of a notification for several new messages in a project's discussion, when the newest one's author is not known. {{message}} is what it says.

row.channel.someone.description: Second line of a notification for several new messages in a project's discussion, when neither the newest message's author nor its text is known.

row.channel.askedIn.description: First line of a notification: a person's message in a project's discussion was filed as a request for a change. {{project}} is the project's name. Their message is on the line below. Keep the @ before the username.

row.channel.askedInUnnamed.text: @{{username}} asked for a change in the discussion
row.channel.askedInUnnamed.description: First line of a notification: a person's message in a project's discussion was filed as a request for a change; the project's name is not known. Keep the @ before the username.

row.channel.someoneAskedIn.text: Someone asked for a change in {{project}}
row.channel.someoneAskedIn.description: First line of a notification: a message from an unknown person in a project's discussion was filed as a request for a change. {{project}} is the project's name.

row.channel.someoneAskedInUnnamed.text: Someone asked for a change in the discussion
row.channel.someoneAskedInUnnamed.description: First line of a notification: a message from an unknown person in a project's discussion was filed as a request for a change; the project's name is not known.

row.channel.saidIn.description: First line of a notification for one new message in a project's group discussion: who wrote it and in which project. {{project}} is the project's name. The message is on the line below. Keep the @ before the username.

row.channel.saidInUnnamed.description: First line of a notification for one new message in a project's group discussion, when the project's name is not known. Keep the @ before the username.

row.channel.someoneIn.description: First line of a notification for one new message in a project's group discussion, when its author is not known. {{project}} is the project's name.

row.channel.someoneInUnnamed.description: First line of a notification for one new message in a project's group discussion, when neither its author nor the project's name is known.

row.inviteLink.openedOne.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link: one person opened it.

row.inviteLink.openedMany_one.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link. {{count}} is how many people opened it; it is always more than one.

row.inviteLink.openedMany_other.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link. {{count}} is how many people opened it; it is always more than one.

row.inviteLink.joined.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link: the person named on the last line joined the project through it.

row.inviteLink.joinedWithOthers_one.text: Joined through your invite, with {{count}} other
row.inviteLink.joinedWithOthers_one.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link: the person named on the last line joined the project through it, and so did {{count}} more people.

row.inviteLink.joinedWithOthers_other.text: Joined through your invite, with {{count}} others
row.inviteLink.joinedWithOthers_other.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link: the person named on the last line joined the project through it, and so did {{count}} more people.

row.inviteLink.asked.description: First line of a notification to the person who made an invite link: the first message of somebody who joined through it was filed as a request for a change. Their message is on the line below and their name on the last line.

row.inviteLink.saidHi.description: First line of a notification to the person who made an invite link: somebody who joined through it wrote their first message. The message is on the line below and their name on the last line.

row.inviteLink.saidHiWithOthers_one.description: First line of a notification to the person who made an invite link: the person named on the last line wrote their first message, and so did {{count}} more people who joined through it.

row.inviteLink.saidHiWithOthers_other.description: First line of a notification to the person who made an invite link: the person named on the last line wrote their first message, and so did {{count}} more people who joined through it.

row.collab.invitedJoin.description: The whole text of a notification: the person named on the last line invited the viewer into the private project named there.

row.collab.invitedBuild.text: Invited you to build with them
row.collab.invitedBuild.description: The whole text of a notification: the person named on the last line invited the viewer to work on the project named there. "Build" is a verb: make the project together.

row.collab.accepted.description: The whole text of a notification: the person named on the last line accepted the viewer's invitation and joined the project.

row.collab.approverInvite.text: Asked you to help approve changes
row.collab.approverInvite.description: The whole text of a notification: the person named on the last line asked the viewer to become one of the people whose approval a project's changes need. "Changes" is a noun.

row.collab.approverAccepted.description: The whole text of a notification: the person named on the last line agreed to become an approver of the project's changes. "Changes" is a noun.

row.chat.mention.description: First line of a notification: somebody named the viewer with @ in a project's chat. The message is on the line below and who wrote it on the last line.

row.chat.reply.description: First line of a notification: somebody replied to the viewer's message in a project's chat. The message is on the line below.

row.chat.threadReply.description: First line of a notification: somebody answered in a reply thread the viewer started or took part in, in a project's chat. The message is on the line below.

row.chat.posted.description: First line of a notification about a chat message of a kind this version does not know. A past-tense verb: "(they) posted", wrote a message. The message is on the line below.

saved.heading.description: Heading over what the viewer bookmarked in the notifications sheet — saved messages and saved notifications — at the top of the screen.

saved.unsave.description: Button beside a saved message or a saved notification in the notifications sheet, and the action revealed by swiping it: removes the bookmark from it.

saved.system.description: Stands for the author of a saved message that the platform itself wrote. Only its first letter is shown, in the round avatar beside the message.

saved.notificationLine.description: First line over a saved notification in the notifications sheet's Saved section: what kind of notification it is, and when it was saved. {{kind}} is the kind line the row shows in the list ("New reply", "Mention"), {{when}} is how long ago it was saved ("2h ago") or a date.

saved.line.author.description: Line over a saved message in the notifications sheet: who wrote it, where, and when it was saved. {{place}} is the name of the project or conversation, {{when}} is how long ago ("2h ago") or a date. Keep the @ before the username.

saved.line.authorConversation.description: Line over a saved message in the notifications sheet when it was written in a conversation that has no name. {{when}} is how long ago it was saved ("2h ago") or a date. Keep the @ before the username.

saved.line.authorApp.description: Line over a saved message in the notifications sheet when it was written in an app's chat and the app's name is not known. {{when}} is how long ago it was saved ("2h ago") or a date. Keep the @ before the username.

saved.line.system.description: Line over a saved message that the platform itself wrote. {{place}} is the name of the project or conversation it is in, {{when}} is how long ago it was saved ("2h ago") or a date.

saved.line.systemConversation.description: Line over a saved message that the platform itself wrote in a conversation that has no name. {{when}} is how long ago it was saved ("2h ago") or a date.

saved.line.systemApp.description: Line over a saved message that the platform itself wrote in an app's chat whose name is not known. {{when}} is how long ago it was saved ("2h ago") or a date.

invite.heading.description: Heading over the invitations waiting for the viewer's answer, at the top of the notifications sheet. A plural noun.

invite.accept.description: Button on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet, and the action revealed by swiping it: accepts the invitation to the project.

invite.decline.description: Button on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet, and the action revealed by swiping it: turns the invitation down.

invite.showMore_one.description: Button under the first pending invitations in the notifications sheet: unfolds the rest. {{count}} is how many are hidden.

invite.showMore_other.description: Button under the first pending invitations in the notifications sheet: unfolds the rest. {{count}} is how many are hidden.

invite.note.description: The inviter's own note, quoted under a pending invitation. {{note}} is what they wrote; only the quotation marks are translated.

invite.someone.description: Stands for the inviter on a pending invitation when their name is not known. Only its first letter is shown, in the round avatar beside the invitation.

invite.members_one.description: Under a pending invitation to a private project. {{count}} is how many members the project has. "It" is the project.

invite.members_other.description: Under a pending invitation to a private project. {{count}} is how many members the project has. "It" is the project.

invite.alreadyIn.description: Under a pending invitation to a project the viewer already belongs to (they joined through a link or the Join button while the invitation was still waiting). "It" is the project.

invite.meta.membersWhen.description: Small line under a pending invitation. {{members}} is the finished phrase saying how many people are in the project and {{when}} how long ago the invitation was sent. Only the separator between them is translated; keep it inside the first tag.

invite.line.approve.text: <0>@{{username}}</0> asked you to help approve changes to <1>{{project}}</1>
invite.line.approve.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. {{username}} asked the viewer to become an approver of changes to {{project}}, the project's name. Keep the @ before the username.

invite.line.approveUnnamed.text: <0>@{{username}}</0> asked you to help approve changes to <1>an app</1>
invite.line.approveUnnamed.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. {{username}} asked the viewer to become an approver of changes to an app whose name is not known. Keep the @ before the username.

invite.line.someoneApprove.text: <0>Someone</0> asked you to help approve changes to <1>{{project}}</1>
invite.line.someoneApprove.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. A person whose name is not known asked the viewer to become an approver of changes to {{project}}, the project's name.

invite.line.someoneApproveUnnamed.text: <0>Someone</0> asked you to help approve changes to <1>an app</1>
invite.line.someoneApproveUnnamed.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. A person whose name is not known asked the viewer to become an approver of changes to an app whose name is not known either.

invite.line.join.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. {{username}} invited the viewer into the private project {{project}}. Keep the @ before the username.

invite.line.joinUnnamed.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. {{username}} invited the viewer into a private project whose name is not known. Keep the @ before the username.

invite.line.someoneJoin.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. A person whose name is not known invited the viewer into the private project {{project}}.

invite.line.someoneJoinUnnamed.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. A person whose name is not known invited the viewer into a private project whose name is not known either.

invite.line.build.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. {{username}} invited the viewer to work on the project {{project}}. "Build" is a verb: make the project together. Keep the @ before the username.

invite.line.buildUnnamed.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. {{username}} invited the viewer to work on an app whose name is not known. "Build" is a verb: make it together. Keep the @ before the username.

invite.line.someoneBuild.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. A person whose name is not known invited the viewer to work on the project {{project}}. "Build" is a verb: make the project together.

invite.line.someoneBuildUnnamed.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. A person whose name is not known invited the viewer to work on an app whose name is not known either. "Build" is a verb: make it together.

invite.acceptFailed.description: Brief message shown when accepting an invitation failed and the server gave no reason. {{status}} is the numeric HTTP status code; keep "HTTP".

invite.acceptedBuild.description: Brief message shown after the viewer accepted an invitation to work on the project {{project}} (the project's name). "Build" is a verb: make the project together.

invite.acceptedBuildUnnamed.text: You can now build this project
invite.acceptedBuildUnnamed.description: Brief message shown after the viewer accepted an invitation to work on a project whose name is not known. "Build" is a verb: make the project together.

invite.declined.description: Brief message shown after the viewer turned a pending invitation down from the notifications sheet.

toast.markAllFailed.text: Couldn’t mark notifications as read. Try again.
toast.markAllFailed.description: Brief message shown when "Mark all read" failed.

toast.markAppFailed.text: Couldn’t mark these notifications as read. Try again.
toast.markAppFailed.description: Brief message shown when the Mark read button beside an app's name on the notifications sheet's Unread filter failed.

toast.clearFailed.text: Couldn’t clear this notification. Try again.
toast.clearFailed.description: Brief message shown when marking one notification as read (clearing it) failed.

toast.saveFailed.text: Couldn’t save this notification. Try again.
toast.saveFailed.description: Brief message shown when saving a notification (pinning it in the Saved section) failed.

toast.unsaveFailed.text: Couldn’t unsave this notification. Try again.
toast.unsaveFailed.description: Brief message shown when removing the save from a saved notification failed.

friend.answerFailed.text: Couldn’t answer this friend request. Try again.
friend.answerFailed.description: Brief message shown when accepting or declining a friend request from its notification failed.

friend.nowFriends.description: Brief message shown after the viewer accepted a friend request from its notification. Keep the @ before the username.

friend.nowFriendsUnnamed.description: Brief message shown after the viewer accepted a friend request from its notification, when the other person's username is not known.

friend.withdrawn.description: Brief message shown when the viewer pressed Accept on a friend request that its sender had already taken back. "Request" is the friend request.

friend.declined.description: Brief message shown after the viewer declined a friend request from its notification. "Request" is the friend request.

alert.change.failed.title.description: Title of the system notification shown when the automatic attempt to build the change a request asked for failed. "Change" is a noun.

alert.change.question.title.description: Title of the system notification shown when the automatic attempt to build the change a request asked for needs an answer from the viewer. "Change" is a noun.

alert.change.ready.title.description: Title of the system notification shown when the change a request asked for was built automatically and can be tried. "Change" is a noun.

alert.change.failed.body.text: The change for request #{{number}} in {{app}} failed. You can retry
alert.change.failed.body.description: Text of the system notification shown when the automatic attempt to build the change a request asked for failed. {{number}} is the request's number. {{app}} is the app's name.

alert.change.failed.bodyYourApp.text: The change for request #{{number}} in your app failed. You can retry
alert.change.failed.bodyYourApp.description: Text of the system notification shown when the automatic attempt to build the change a request asked for failed and the app's name is not known. {{number}} is the request's number.

alert.change.failed.bodyARequest.text: The change for a request in {{app}} failed. You can retry
alert.change.failed.bodyARequest.description: Text of the system notification shown when the automatic attempt to build the change a request asked for failed and the request's number is not known. {{app}} is the app's name.

alert.change.failed.bodyARequestYourApp.text: The change for a request in your app failed. You can retry
alert.change.failed.bodyARequestYourApp.description: Text of the system notification shown when the automatic attempt to build the change a request asked for failed, when neither the request's number nor the app's name is known.

alert.change.question.body.text: The change for request #{{number}} in {{app}} is waiting for your input
alert.change.question.body.description: Text of the system notification shown when the automatic attempt to build the change a request asked for needs an answer from the viewer. {{number}} is the request's number. {{app}} is the app's name.

alert.change.question.bodyYourApp.text: The change for request #{{number}} in your app is waiting for your input
alert.change.question.bodyYourApp.description: Text of the system notification shown when the automatic attempt to build the change a request asked for needs an answer from the viewer and the app's name is not known. {{number}} is the request's number.

alert.change.question.bodyARequest.text: The change for a request in {{app}} is waiting for your input
alert.change.question.bodyARequest.description: Text of the system notification shown when the automatic attempt to build the change a request asked for needs an answer from the viewer and the request's number is not known. {{app}} is the app's name.

alert.change.question.bodyARequestYourAp.text: The change for a request in your app is waiting for your input
alert.change.question.bodyARequestYourAp.description: Text of the system notification shown when the automatic attempt to build the change a request asked for needs an answer from the viewer, when neither the request's number nor the app's name is known.

alert.change.ready.body.text: The change for request #{{number}} in {{app}} is ready
