alert.change.ready.body.description: Text of the system notification shown when the change a request asked for was built automatically and can be tried. {{number}} is the request's number. {{app}} is the app's name.

alert.change.ready.bodyYourApp.text: The change for request #{{number}} in your app is ready
alert.change.ready.bodyYourApp.description: Text of the system notification shown when the change a request asked for was built automatically and the app's name is not known. {{number}} is the request's number.

alert.change.ready.bodyARequest.text: The change for a request in {{app}} is ready
alert.change.ready.bodyARequest.description: Text of the system notification shown when the change a request asked for was built automatically and the request's number is not known. {{app}} is the app's name.

alert.change.ready.bodyARequestYourApp.text: The change for a request in your app is ready
alert.change.ready.bodyARequestYourApp.description: Text of the system notification shown when the change a request asked for was built automatically, when neither the request's number nor the app's name is known.

alert.stalled.title.description: Title of the system notification shown when the viewer's coding session ended early, by an error or a timeout.

alert.stalled.body.text: Your session on {{app}} stopped before finishing. Open it to continue
alert.stalled.body.description: Text of the system notification shown when the viewer's coding session ended early. {{app}} is the app's name. "Open" is a verb: open the session.

alert.stalled.bodyYourApp.text: Your session on your app stopped before finishing. Open it to continue
alert.stalled.bodyYourApp.description: Text of the system notification shown when the viewer's coding session ended early and the app's name is not known. "Open" is a verb: open the session.

alert.agentDone.title.description: Title of the system notification shown when the AI coding agent finished the work it was given in an agent session.

alert.agentDone.body.description: Text of the system notification shown when the AI coding agent finished its work. {{app}} is the app's name. {{title}} is the session's title.

alert.agentDone.bodyYourApp.text: The coding agent finished on your app: {{title}}
alert.agentDone.bodyYourApp.description: Text of the system notification shown when the AI coding agent finished its work and the app's name is not known. {{title}} is the session's title.

alert.agentDone.bodyYourSession.text: The coding agent finished on {{app}}: your session
alert.agentDone.bodyYourSession.description: Text of the system notification shown when the AI coding agent finished its work and the session has no title. {{app}} is the app's name.

alert.agentDone.bodyYourAppYourSession.text: The coding agent finished on your app: your session
alert.agentDone.bodyYourAppYourSession.description: Text of the system notification shown when the AI coding agent finished its work, when neither the app's name nor the session's title is known.

alert.sessionDone.title.description: Title of the system notification shown when the viewer's coding session finished its turn while they were away.

alert.sessionDone.body.description: Text of the system notification shown when the viewer's coding session finished its turn. {{app}} is the app's name. {{title}} is the session's title.

alert.sessionDone.bodyYourApp.text: Your agent session in your app finished: {{title}}
alert.sessionDone.bodyYourApp.description: Text of the system notification shown when the viewer's coding session finished its turn and the app's name is not known. {{title}} is the session's title.

alert.sessionDone.bodyYourSession.text: Your agent session in {{app}} finished: your session
alert.sessionDone.bodyYourSession.description: Text of the system notification shown when the viewer's coding session finished its turn and the session has no title. {{app}} is the app's name.

alert.sessionDone.bodyYourAppYourSession.text: Your agent session in your app finished: your session
alert.sessionDone.bodyYourAppYourSession.description: Text of the system notification shown when the viewer's coding session finished its turn, when neither the app's name nor the session's title is known.

row.chat.requestReply.description: First line of a notification: somebody posted in the discussion of a request the viewer filed or posted in. {{number}} is the request's number. "Request" is a noun: something people asked a project for. The message is on the line below.

row.chat.requestReplyUnnumbered.description: First line of a notification: somebody posted in the discussion of a request the viewer filed or posted in, when the request's number is not known. "Request" is a noun: something people asked a project for. The message is on the line below.

row.projectOpened.label.description: A notification row in the notifications sheet: a project the reader joined while it was still being made has just gone live. The project's name is shown on the line beside it. "It" is the project.

ask.invite_sent.title.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. This one appears right after the person sent an invite link to their project.

ask.invite_sent.body.text: We’ll tell you when someone opens your invite, and when they join.
ask.invite_sent.body.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. The line under the title, after an invite link was sent.

ask.suggestion.title.text: Get a ping when it’s ready?
ask.suggestion.title.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. This one appears after the person suggested a change that Homeroom bot (the platform's assistant) is now building.

ask.suggestion.body.text: Homeroom bot will message you when your idea is ready to try.
ask.suggestion.body.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. The line under the title, after a suggestion Homeroom bot is building.

ask.reply.title.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. This one appears after the person sent a message to someone, or in a project's chat.

ask.reply.body.text: Get a notification when somebody replies to you.
ask.reply.body.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. The line under the title, after a message was sent.

ask.community.title.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. This one appears on the page of a project (a community) the person joined. {{project}} is the project's name.

ask.community.small.body.text: Get a notification when the group writes here, and when a change needs your vote.
ask.community.small.body.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. The line under the title, on a small private project where every message notifies the group.

ask.community.large.body.text: Get a notification when a change needs your vote, and when somebody replies to you.
ask.community.large.body.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. The line under the title, on a larger or public project where ordinary messages do not notify everyone.

ask.project_opens.title.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. This one appears to somebody who joined a project that is still being made. {{project}} is the project's name.

ask.project_opens.body.text: We’ll tell you as soon as it’s ready to use.
ask.project_opens.body.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. The line under the title, on a project still being made.

ask.notifyMe.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. The card's main button: yes, notify me.

ask.notNow.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. The card's second button: closes the card without turning anything on.

ask.on.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. What the card says, with a check mark, once notifications are on.

ask.off.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. What the card says when the phone's settings refused notifications.

ask.turnOn.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. A button beside that line that opens the phone's notification settings for Homeroom.

ask.web.title.app_building.text: Get the app to hear when it’s ready
ask.web.title.app_building.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. Shown while Homeroom bot builds the person's new project.

ask.web.title.invite_sent.text: Get the app to hear when they join
ask.web.title.invite_sent.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. Shown right after the person sent an invite link.

ask.web.title.suggestion.text: Get the app to hear when it’s ready
ask.web.title.suggestion.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. Shown after a suggestion Homeroom bot is now building.

ask.web.title.reply.text: Get the app to hear when they answer
ask.web.title.reply.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. Shown after the person sent a message.

ask.web.title.community.text: Get the app to hear from {{project}}
ask.web.title.community.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. Shown on a project the person joined. {{project}} is the project's name.

ask.web.title.project_opens.text: Get the app to hear when {{project}} opens
ask.web.title.project_opens.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. Shown on a project still being made. {{project}} is the project's name.

ask.web.body.text: Homeroom’s notifications come through its phone app.
ask.web.body.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. The line under the title.

ask.web.bodyEmail.text: Homeroom’s notifications come through its phone app. Until then, we’ll email you.
ask.web.bodyEmail.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. The line under the title, in place of the one above, when Homeroom emails the person about this moment while they have no app.

ask.web.getApp.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. The card's main button: opens the app's store page, or on a computer a code to scan with a phone.

ask.sheet.title.description: Title of a small sheet opened from the notification ask's Get the app button on a computer. It shows a code to scan with a phone.

ask.sheet.scan.text: Scan this with your phone’s camera. It opens the app’s page in your phone’s store.
ask.sheet.scan.description: Under that title, beside the code to scan.

ask.sheet.or.text: Or open the store on your phone
ask.sheet.or.description: Small heading over links to the app's store pages, under the code to scan.

ask.sheet.codeLabel.text: Code to scan for the Homeroom app
ask.sheet.codeLabel.description: Accessible name of the code image on that sheet.
